```ruby title="Ruby"

  def visit_details(ctx, is_open)

  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Main content here.</p><details><summary>Hidden section</summary><p>Secret details</p></details><p>More main content.</p>', visitor)
```
